title.zh: 卷一百三十二 列傳第二十 朱亮祖 周德興 王弼 藍玉 謝成 李新
title.en: Volume 132 Biographies 20: Zhu Liangzu, Zhou Dexing, Wang Bi, Lan Yu, Xie Cheng, Li Xin
title.raw: 卷一百三十二 列傳第二十 朱亮祖 周德興 王弼 藍玉 謝成 李新 Volume 132 Biographies 20: Zhu Liangzu, Zhou Dexing, Wang Bi, Lan Yu, Xie Cheng, Li Xin

sentences.zh: 硃亮祖

translations.literal: Zhu Liangzu
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Liangzu

sentences.zh: 硃亮祖，六安人。

translations.literal: Zhu Liangzu was a man of Lu'an.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Liangzu was a native of Lu'an.

sentences.zh: 元授義兵元帥。

translations.literal: The Yuan appointed him Marshal of the Righteous Army.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan court appointed him marshal of the righteous-army forces.

sentences.zh: 太祖克寧國，擒亮祖，喜其勇悍，賜金幣，仍舊官。

translations.literal: The Taizu captured Ningguo and seized Liangzu; pleased with his fierce bravery, he bestowed gold and coins and restored his former office.
translations.idiomatic: When the Taizu took Ningguo, he captured Liangzu. Delighted by his fierce courage, he rewarded him with gold and coin and restored him to his former post.

sentences.zh: 居數月，叛歸於元，數與我兵戰，為所獲者六千余人，遂入宣城據之。

translations.literal: After several months he rebelled and returned to the Yuan; he fought repeatedly with our troops, and those captured by him numbered more than six thousand; he then entered Xuancheng and held it.
translations.idiomatic: After a few months he defected back to the Yuan and fought our forces repeatedly, taking more than six thousand prisoners. He then entered Xuancheng and seized it.

sentences.zh: 太祖方取建康，未暇討也。

translations.literal: The Taizu was then taking Jiankang and had no leisure to punish him.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu was then occupied with the capture of Jiankang and had no time to deal with him.

sentences.zh: 已，遣徐達等圍之。

translations.literal: Later he sent Xu Da and others to besiege him.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward he sent Xu Da and others to besiege the city.

sentences.zh: 亮祖突圍戰，常遇春被創而還，諸將莫敢前。

translations.literal: Liangzu broke out and fought; Chang Yuchun was wounded and withdrew, and none of the generals dared advance.
translations.idiomatic: Liangzu sallied out to fight. Chang Yuchun was wounded and pulled back, and none of the other generals dared press forward.

sentences.zh: 太祖親往督戰，獲之，縛以見。

translations.literal: The Taizu went in person to supervise the battle, captured him, and bound him to be brought before him.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu went in person to direct the assault, captured him, and had him bound and brought before him.

sentences.zh: 問曰：「爾將何如？

translations.literal: He asked, saying, "What will you do?
translations.idiomatic: He asked, "What do you intend to do?

sentences.zh: 」對曰：「生則儘力，死則死耳！

translations.literal: " He replied, saying, "While alive I shall exhaust my strength; when I die, death is all!
translations.idiomatic: " Liangzu answered, "While I live I shall give my utmost; when I die, so be it!

sentences.zh: 」太祖壯而釋之。

translations.literal: " The Taizu admired him and released him.
translations.idiomatic: " The Taizu was impressed and set him free.

sentences.zh: 累功授樞密院判。

translations.literal: Through accumulated merit he was appointed Vice-Director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: For accumulated merit he was appointed vice-director of the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 從下南昌、九江，戰鄱陽湖，下武昌。

translations.literal: He followed in the reduction of Nanchang and Jiujiang, fought at Poyang Lake, and took Wuchang.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the campaigns that took Nanchang and Jiujiang, fought at Lake Poyang, and captured Wuchang.

sentences.zh: 進廣信衛指揮使。

translations.literal: He was advanced to Commander of the Guangxin Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to commander of the Guangxin Guard.

sentences.zh: 李文忠破李伯升於新城，亮祖乘勝燔其營落數十，獲同僉元帥等六百余人、軍士三千、馬八百匹，輜重鎧甲無算。

translations.literal: Li Wenzhong defeated Li Bosheng at Xincheng; Liangzu pressed the victory and burned several dozen of his encampments, capturing more than six hundred men including the Vice-Censor-in-Chief and Marshal, three thousand soldiers, eight hundred horses, and countless baggage, armor, and equipment.
translations.idiomatic: When Li Wenzhong defeated Li Bosheng at Xincheng, Liangzu pressed the advantage and burned dozens of enemy camps. He captured more than six hundred men including a vice-censor-in-chief and marshal, three thousand troops, eight hundred horses, and incalculable stores of baggage, armor, and equipment.

sentences.zh: 伯升僅以數騎遁。

translations.literal: Bosheng escaped with only a few horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: Bosheng himself escaped with only a handful of horsemen.

sentences.zh: 太祖嘉其功，賜賚甚厚。

translations.literal: The Taizu praised his merit and bestowed rewards very generously.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu commended his achievement and rewarded him very generously.

sentences.zh: 胡深請會兵攻陳友定，亮祖由鉛山進取浦城，克崇安、建陽，功最多。

translations.literal: Hu Shen requested a joint force to attack Chen Youding; Liangzu advanced from Qianshan to take Pucheng and captured Chong'an and Jianyang, his merit being the greatest.
translations.idiomatic: When Hu Shen asked for combined forces to attack Chen Youding, Liangzu advanced from Qianshan to take Pucheng and captured Chong'an and Jianyang, contributing more than any other commander.

sentences.zh: 會攻桐廬，圍余杭。

translations.literal: He joined in the attack on Tonglu and besieged Yuhang.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the assault on Tonglu and helped besiege Yuhang.

sentences.zh: 遷浙江行省參政，副李文忠守杭州。

translations.literal: He was transferred to be Administrative Commissioner of the Zhejiang Branch Secretariat and assisted Li Wenzhong in defending Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to administrative commissioner of the Zhejiang branch secretariat and served under Li Wenzhong in the defense of Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 帥馬步舟師數萬討方國瑛。

translations.literal: He commanded cavalry, infantry, and naval forces numbering tens of thousands to campaign against Fang Guoying.
translations.idiomatic: He led a combined force of tens of thousands of cavalry, infantry, and ships against Fang Guoying.

sentences.zh: 下天台，進攻台州。

translations.literal: He took Tiantai and advanced to attack Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He captured Tiantai and pressed on to attack Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 國瑛出走，追至黃岩，降其守將哈兒魯，徇下仙居諸縣。

translations.literal: Guoying fled; he pursued to Huangyan, induced the surrender of the defending general Ha'erlu, and pacified the counties of Xianju and others.
translations.idiomatic: Guoying fled. Liangzu pursued him to Huangyan, accepted the surrender of the defending general Ha'erlu, and brought the counties around Xianju under control.

sentences.zh: 進兵溫州。

translations.literal: He advanced his army to Wenzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He then advanced on Wenzhou.

sentences.zh: 方明善拒戰，擊敗之，克其城。

translations.literal: Fang Mingshan resisted in battle; he defeated him and captured the city.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Mingshan resisted, but Liangzu defeated him and took the city.

sentences.zh: 徇下瑞安，覆敗明善於盤嶼，追至楚門。

translations.literal: He pacified Rui'an, routed Mingshan again at Panyu, and pursued to Chumen.
translations.idiomatic: He brought Rui'an under control, routed Mingshan again at Panyu, and pursued him as far as Chumen.

sentences.zh: 國瑛及明善詣軍降。

translations.literal: Guoying and Mingshan came to the army and surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Guoying and Mingshan then came to the camp and surrendered.

sentences.zh: 洪武元年，副征南將軍廖永忠由海道取廣東。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongwu he served as deputy to the Southern Expedition General Liao Yongzhong and took Guangdong by the sea route.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongwu he served under the southern expedition general Liao Yongzhong and took Guangdong by sea.

sentences.zh: 何真降，悉定其地。

translations.literal: He Zhen surrendered, and the entire region was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: When He Zhen surrendered, the whole region was brought under control.

sentences.zh: 進取廣西，克梧州。

translations.literal: He advanced to take Guangxi and captured Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He then advanced into Guangxi and captured Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 元尚書普賢帖木兒戰死，遂定郁林、潯、貴諸郡。

translations.literal: The Yuan Minister Puxian Timur died in battle, and he then pacified the prefectures of Yulin, Xun, and Gui.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan minister Puxian Timur was killed in battle, after which Liangzu secured the prefectures of Yulin, Xun, and Gui.

sentences.zh: 與平章楊璟會師，攻克靖江。

translations.literal: He joined forces with the Pacification Commissioner Yang Jing and captured Jingjiang.
translations.idiomatic: He joined forces with the pacification commissioner Yang Jing and captured Jingjiang.

sentences.zh: 同廖永忠克南寧、象州。

translations.literal: Together with Liao Yongzhong he captured Nanning and Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Liao Yongzhong he took Nanning and Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 廣西平。

translations.literal: Guangxi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi was fully pacified.

sentences.zh: 班師，太子帥百官迎勞龍灣。

translations.literal: The army returned; the crown prince led the hundred officials to welcome and congratulate them at Longwan.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return, the crown prince led the officials out to welcome and honor them at Longwan.

sentences.zh: 三年封永嘉侯，食祿千五百石，予世券。

translations.literal: In the third year he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yongjia with an income of one thousand five hundred piculs of grain and granted a hereditary patent.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yongjia with an income of 1,500 piculs of grain and granted a hereditary patent of nobility.

sentences.zh: 四年伐蜀。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Shu was attacked.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the court launched the campaign against Shu.

sentences.zh: 帝以諸將久無功，命亮祖為征虜右副將軍。

translations.literal: The emperor, because the generals had long achieved no success, appointed Liangzu Right Vice-General of the Expedition against the Barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: Because the generals had long failed to make progress, the emperor appointed Liangzu right vice-general of the expedition against the barbarians.

sentences.zh: 濟師至蜀，而明升已降。

translations.literal: He crossed the army to Shu, but Ming Sheng had already surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: By the time his forces reached Shu, Ming Sheng had already surrendered.

sentences.zh: 徇下未附州縣。

translations.literal: He pacified the prefectures and counties that had not yet submitted.
translations.idiomatic: He then brought the remaining unsubmitted prefectures and counties under control.

sentences.zh: 師還，以擅殺軍校，不預賞。

translations.literal: When the army returned, because he had killed military officers on his own authority, he was not included in the rewards.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was excluded from the rewards because he had executed military officers on his own authority.

sentences.zh: 八年同傅友德鎮北平。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he joined Fu Youde in garrisoning Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he joined Fu Youde in garrisoning Beiping.

sentences.zh: 還，又同李善長督理屯田，巡海道。

translations.literal: On his return he again joined Li Shanchang in supervising military colonies and patrolling the coastal routes.
translations.idiomatic: After returning he again worked with Li Shanchang to supervise military colonies and patrol the coastal routes.

sentences.zh: 十二年出鎮廣東。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he went out to command Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was sent out to command Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 亮祖勇悍善戰而不知學，所為多不法，番遇知縣道同以聞。

translations.literal: Liangzu was fierce and skilled in battle but ignorant of learning; his actions were mostly unlawful, and the Fan Prefecture magistrate Dao Tong reported this.
translations.idiomatic: Liangzu was fierce and skilled in battle but unlearned, and much of what he did was unlawful. The magistrate of Fan Prefecture, Dao Tong, reported him to the throne.

sentences.zh: 亮祖誣奏同，同死，事見同傳。

translations.literal: Liangzu lodged a false accusation against Tong; Tong died—the matter is recorded in Tong's biography.
translations.idiomatic: Liangzu lodged a false accusation against him, and Tong was put to death. The affair is recorded in Tong's biography.

sentences.zh: 帝尋悟，明年九月召亮祖至，與其子府軍衛指揮使暹俱鞭死。

translations.literal: The emperor soon understood; in the ninth month of the following year he summoned Liangzu, and together with his son Xian, commander of the Palace Guard, both were beaten to death.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor soon realized his error. In the ninth month of the following year he summoned Liangzu and had him and his son Xian, commander of the Palace Guard, beaten to death.

sentences.zh: 御制壙志，仍以侯禮葬。

translations.literal: The emperor composed an epitaph for the tomb and still buried him with marquis rites.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor composed an epitaph for his tomb and still buried him with the rites due a marquis.

sentences.zh: 二十三年追論亮祖胡惟庸黨，次子昱亦坐誅。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Liangzu was posthumously judged a member of Hu Weiyong's faction; his second son Yu was also executed by association.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year Liangzu was posthumously condemned as a member of Hu Weiyong's faction, and his second son Yu was executed as well.

sentences.zh: 周德興

translations.literal: Zhou Dexing
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Dexing

sentences.zh: 周德興，濠人。

translations.literal: Zhou Dexing was a man of Hao.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou Dexing was a native of Hao.

sentences.zh: 與太祖同里，少相得。

translations.literal: He was from the same village as the Taizu and from youth they were well matched.
translations.idiomatic: He came from the same village as the Taizu, and the two had been close since youth.

sentences.zh: 從定滁、和。

translations.literal: He followed in the pacification of Chu and He.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the campaigns that secured Chu and He.

sentences.zh: 渡江，累戰皆有功，遷左翼大元帥。

translations.literal: Crossing the river, he fought repeatedly with merit and was transferred to Grand Marshal of the Left Wing.
translations.idiomatic: After the crossing of the Yangzi he fought in battle after battle with distinction and was promoted to grand marshal of the left wing.

sentences.zh: 從取金華、安慶、高郵。

translations.literal: He followed in the capture of Jinhua, Anqing, and Gaoyou.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in the capture of Jinhua, Anqing, and Gaoyou.

sentences.zh: 援安豐，征廬州，進指揮使。

translations.literal: He relieved Anfeng, campaigned against Luzhou, and was advanced to Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He relieved Anfeng, campaigned against Luzhou, and was promoted to commander.

sentences.zh: 從討贛州、安福、永新，拔吉安。

translations.literal: He followed in the suppression of Ganzhou, Anfu, and Yongxin and captured Ji'an.
translations.idiomatic: He joined the campaigns against Ganzhou, Anfu, and Yongxin and captured Ji'an.

sentences.zh: 再進湖廣行省左丞。

translations.literal: He was again advanced to Left Vice-Minister of the Huguang Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was further promoted to left vice-minister of the Huguang branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 同楊璟討廣西，攻永州。

translations.literal: Together with Yang Jing he campaigned in Guangxi and attacked Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Together with Yang Jing he campaigned in Guangxi and attacked Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 元平章阿思蘭及周文貴自全州來援，德興再擊敗之，斬硃院判。

translations.literal: The Yuan Pacification Commissioner Aslan and Zhou Wengui came from Quanzhou to relieve the city; Dexing again defeated them and beheaded the Vice-Censor Zhu.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan pacification commissioner Aslan and Zhou Wengui marched from Quanzhou to relieve the city, but Dexing defeated them again and beheaded the vice-censor Zhu.

sentences.zh: 追奔至全州，遂克之。

translations.literal: He pursued the rout to Quanzhou and then captured it.
translations.idiomatic: He pursued the fleeing enemy to Quanzhou and captured the city.

sentences.zh: 道州、寧州、藍山皆下。

translations.literal: Daozhou, Ningzhou, and Lanshan all fell.
translations.idiomatic: Daozhou, Ningzhou, and Lanshan all submitted.

sentences.zh: 進克武岡州，分兵據險，絕靖江聲援。

translations.literal: He advanced and captured Wugang Prefecture, divided his troops to hold the strategic passes, and cut off Jingjiang's reinforcements.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced and captured Wugang Prefecture, posted troops at the strategic passes, and cut off reinforcements to Jingjiang.

sentences.zh: 廣西平，功多。

translations.literal: When Guangxi was pacified, his merit was great.
translations.idiomatic: When Guangxi was pacified, his contributions were among the greatest.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年封江夏侯，歲祿千五百石，予世券。

translations.literal: In the third year of Hongwu he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jiangxia with an annual income of one thousand five hundred piculs of grain and granted a hereditary patent.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Hongwu he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jiangxia with an annual income of 1,500 piculs of grain and granted a hereditary patent of nobility.

sentences.zh: 是歲，慈利土酋覃垕連茅岡諸寨為亂，長沙洞苗俱煽動。

translations.literal: That year the Cili tribal chief Tan Hao linked the stockades of Maogang and others in rebellion, and the Miao of Changsha Cave were all stirred up.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Cili tribal chief Tan Hao rallied the stockades of Maogang and other strongholds in revolt, and the Miao of Changsha Cave rose as well.

sentences.zh: 太祖命德興為征南將軍，帥師討平之。

translations.literal: The Taizu appointed Dexing Southern Expedition General and commanded an army to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu appointed Dexing southern expedition general and sent him with an army to suppress the uprising.

sentences.zh: 明年伐蜀，副湯和為征西左將軍，克保寧。

translations.literal: The next year Shu was attacked; he served as deputy to Tang He as Left General of the Western Expedition and captured Baoning.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, in the campaign against Shu, he served under Tang He as left general of the western expedition and captured Baoning.

sentences.zh: 先是，傅友德已克階、文，而和所帥舟師未進。

translations.literal: Earlier Fu Youde had already captured Jie and Wen, but the naval force commanded by He had not advanced.
translations.idiomatic: By then Fu Youde had already taken Jie and Wen, but the fleet under Tang He had not yet advanced.

sentences.zh: 及保寧下，兩路軍始合。

translations.literal: When Baoning fell, the two armies at last united.
translations.idiomatic: Only after Baoning fell did the two armies finally join.

sentences.zh: 蜀平，論功，帝以和功由德興，賞德興而面責和。

translations.literal: When Shu was pacified and merit was assessed, the emperor held that He's achievement came through Dexing; he rewarded Dexing and rebuked He to his face.
translations.idiomatic: After Shu was pacified, the emperor judged that Tang He's success owed chiefly to Dexing. He rewarded Dexing and rebuked Tang He to his face.

sentences.zh: 且追數征蠻事，謂覃垕之役，楊璟不能克，趙庸中道返，功無與德興比者。

translations.literal: He further recounted several campaigns against the barbarians, saying that in the Tan Hao affair Yang Jing could not overcome them and Zhao Yong turned back midway—no achievement could compare with Dexing's.
translations.idiomatic: He went on to recount Dexing's campaigns against the tribal peoples, noting that in the Tan Hao affair Yang Jing had failed to prevail and Zhao Yong had turned back midway. No other commander could match his record.

sentences.zh: 復副鄧愈為征南左將軍，帥趙庸、左君弼出南寧，平婪鳳、安田諸州蠻，克泗城州，功復出諸將上。

translations.literal: He again served as deputy to Deng Yu as Left General of the Southern Expedition, leading Zhao Yong and Zuo Junbi out from Nanning to pacify the barbarians of Lanfeng, Antian, and other prefectures and capture Sicheng Prefecture; his merit again surpassed the other generals.
translations.idiomatic: He again served under Deng Yu as left general of the southern expedition, leading Zhao Yong and Zuo Junbi out from Nanning to pacify the tribal peoples of Lanfeng, Antian, and neighboring prefectures and to capture Sicheng Prefecture. Once more his achievements surpassed those of every other commander.

sentences.zh: 賞倍於大將，命署中立府，行大都督府事。

translations.literal: His reward was double that of the chief commander; he was ordered to act as director of Zhongli Prefecture and perform the duties of the Chief Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: His reward was twice that of the chief commander, and he was ordered to act as director of Zhongli Prefecture and discharge the duties of the chief military commission.

sentences.zh: 德興功既盛，且恃帝故人，營第宅逾制。

translations.literal: Dexing's achievements were already great, and relying on being an old acquaintance of the emperor, he built a residence exceeding the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Dexing's achievements were now immense, and counting on his long friendship with the emperor, he built a residence that exceeded what the regulations allowed.

sentences.zh: 有司列其罪，詔特宥之。

translations.literal: The responsible officials listed his offenses, but an edict specially pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible officials reported his offenses, but an edict specially pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 十三年命理福建軍務，旋召還。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was ordered to oversee Fujian military affairs and was soon recalled.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was ordered to oversee military affairs in Fujian, but was soon recalled.

sentences.zh: 明年，五溪蠻亂。

translations.literal: The next year the Five Streams barbarians rebelled.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the peoples of the Five Streams rose in revolt.

sentences.zh: 德興已老，力請行，帝壯而遣之，賜手書曰：「趙充國圖征西羌，馬援請討交址，朕常嘉其事，謂今人所難。

translations.literal: Dexing was already old but strenuously requested to go; the emperor admired this and sent him forth, bestowing a letter in his own hand, saying, "Zhao Chongguo planned the campaign against the Western Qiang, and Ma Yuan requested to attack Jiaozhi—I have always praised these deeds, holding them difficult for men of today.
translations.idiomatic: Dexing was already old but begged to be allowed to go. The emperor was moved and sent him off, writing in his own hand: "Zhao Chongguo planned the campaign against the Western Qiang, and Ma Yuan asked to attack Jiaozhi. I have always admired such deeds and considered them beyond what men of today can do.

sentences.zh: 卿忠勤不怠，何忝前賢，靖亂安民，在此行也。

translations.literal: Your loyalty and diligence without slackening—how could you shame the former worthies? To pacify disorder and settle the people lies in this expedition.
translations.idiomatic: Your loyalty and tireless diligence do not fall short of those earlier worthies. To pacify disorder and secure the people depends on this campaign.

sentences.zh: 」至五溪，蠻悉散走。

translations.literal: " When he reached the Five Streams, the barbarians all scattered and fled.
translations.idiomatic: " When he reached the Five Streams, the rebels all scattered and fled.

sentences.zh: 會四川水盡源、通塔平諸洞作亂，仍命德興討平之。

translations.literal: At the same time the caves of Shuijinyuan, Tongtaping, and others in Sichuan rebelled, and he was again ordered to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: At the same time the cave peoples of Shuijinyuan, Tongtaping, and other districts in Sichuan rose in revolt, and Dexing was again ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 十八年，楚王楨討思州五開蠻，復以德興為副將軍。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year Prince Zhu Zhen of Chu campaigned against the barbarians of Sizhou and Wukai; Dexing was again made vice-general.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year Prince Zhu Zhen of Chu campaigned against the tribal peoples of Sizhou and Wukai, and Dexing was again appointed vice-general.

sentences.zh: 德興在楚久，所用皆楚卒，威震蠻中。

translations.literal: Dexing had long been in Chu and employed only Chu soldiers; his authority awed the barbarian regions.
translations.idiomatic: Dexing had long served in Chu and used only Chu troops, and his authority awed the tribal regions.

sentences.zh: 定武昌等十五衛，歲練軍士四萬四千八百人。

translations.literal: He established fifteen guards including Wuchang and annually trained forty-four thousand eight hundred soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: He organized fifteen guards including Wuchang and each year trained 44,800 soldiers.

sentences.zh: 決荊州岳山壩以溉田，歲增官租四千三百石。

translations.literal: He breached the Yueshan Dam in Jingzhou to irrigate fields, increasing official rent by four thousand three hundred piculs per year.
translations.idiomatic: He breached the Yueshan Dam in Jingzhou to irrigate fields, increasing official grain rent by 4,300 piculs a year.

sentences.zh: 楚人德之。

translations.literal: The people of Chu were grateful to him.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Chu were deeply grateful to him.

sentences.zh: 還鄉，賜黃金二百兩，白金二千兩，文綺百匹。

translations.literal: On his return to his home district he was granted two hundred taels of gold, two thousand taels of silver, and one hundred bolts of patterned silk.
translations.idiomatic: When he returned home he was granted 200 taels of gold, 2,000 taels of silver, and 100 bolts of patterned silk.

sentences.zh: 居無何，帝謂德興：「福建功未竟，卿雖老，尚勉為朕行。

translations.literal: Before long had passed, the emperor said to Dexing, "The work in Fujian is not yet finished; though you are old, you should still strive to go for me.
translations.idiomatic: Before long the emperor told Dexing, "The work in Fujian is not yet finished. Though you are old, I still ask you to go for me.

sentences.zh: 」德興至閩，按籍僉練，得民兵十萬余人。

translations.literal: " Dexing reached Fujian, mustered and trained according to the registers, and obtained more than one hundred thousand militia.
translations.idiomatic: " Dexing went to Fujian, mustered and trained men according to the registers, and raised a militia of more than 100,000.

sentences.zh: 相視要害，築城一十六，置巡司四十有五，防海之策始備。

translations.literal: He surveyed the strategic points, built sixteen walled cities, and established forty-five patrol offices; the policy for coastal defense was then complete.
translations.idiomatic: He surveyed the strategic points, built sixteen walled posts, and established forty-five patrol offices, completing the coastal defense system.

sentences.zh: 逾三年，歸第，復令節制鳳陽留守司，並訓練屬衛軍士。

translations.literal: After more than three years he returned to his residence and was again ordered to command the Fengyang Garrison Command and train the soldiers of the subordinate guards.
translations.idiomatic: After more than three years he returned home and was again ordered to command the Fengyang garrison headquarters and train the troops of its subordinate guards.

sentences.zh: 諸勛臣存者，德興年最高。

translations.literal: Among the surviving meritorious ministers, Dexing was the eldest in years.
translations.idiomatic: Of the meritorious ministers still living, Dexing was the oldest.

sentences.zh: 歲時入朝，賜予不絕。

translations.literal: Each year when he came to court, gifts and grants were unceasing.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever he came to court on the annual schedule, gifts and grants never ceased.

sentences.zh: 二十五年八月，以其子驥亂宮，並坐誅死。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year, because his son Ji disturbed the palace, both were executed by association.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the twenty-fifth year, because his son Ji was implicated in a plot against the palace, both father and son were executed.

sentences.zh: 王弼，其先定遠人，後徙臨淮。

translations.literal: Wang Bi—his ancestors were men of Dingyuan, and later the family moved to Linhuai.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Bi's family was originally from Dingyuan and later moved to Linhuai.

sentences.zh: 善用雙刀，號「雙刀王」。

translations.literal: He was skilled in the use of paired sabers and was called "King Double-Saber."
translations.idiomatic: He was skilled with paired sabers and was known as "King Double-Saber."

sentences.zh: 初結鄉里，依三台山樹柵自保。

translations.literal: At first he gathered his village, relying on Santai Mountain to build palisades for self-defense.
translations.idiomatic: At first he rallied his neighbors and, relying on Santai Mountain, built palisades to defend themselves.

sentences.zh: 逾年，帥所部來歸。

translations.literal: After more than a year he led his followers to submit.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he led his followers to join the cause.

sentences.zh: 太祖知其才，使備宿衛。

translations.literal: The Taizu knew his talent and had him serve in the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu recognized his ability and assigned him to the palace guard.

sentences.zh: 破張士誠兵於湖州，取池州石埭，攻婺源州，斬守將鐵木兒不花，拔其城，獲甲三千。

translations.literal: He defeated Zhang Shicheng's troops at Huzhou, took Shidi in Chizhou, attacked Wuyuan Prefecture, beheaded the defending general Temür Buqa, captured the city, and obtained three thousand suits of armor.
translations.idiomatic: He defeated Zhang Shicheng's forces at Huzhou, took Shidi in Chizhou, attacked Wuyuan Prefecture, beheaded the defending general Temür Buqa, captured the city, and seized three thousand suits of armor.

sentences.zh: 擢元帥。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Marshal.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to marshal.

sentences.zh: 下蘭溪、金華、諸暨。

translations.literal: He took Lanxi, Jinhua, and Zhuji.
translations.idiomatic: He captured Lanxi, Jinhua, and Zhuji.

sentences.zh: 援池州，復太平，下龍興、吉安。

translations.literal: He relieved Chizhou, recovered Taiping, and took Longxing and Ji'an.
translations.idiomatic: He relieved Chizhou, recovered Taiping, and captured Longxing and Ji'an.

sentences.zh: 大戰鄱陽，邀擊陳友諒於涇江口。

translations.literal: In the great battle at Poyang he intercepted Chen Youliang at the mouth of the Jing River.
translations.idiomatic: At the great battle on Lake Poyang he intercepted Chen Youliang at the mouth of the Jing River.

sentences.zh: 從平武昌，還克廬州。

translations.literal: He followed in the pacification of Wuchang and on the return captured Luzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in the pacification of Wuchang and on the return march captured Luzhou.

sentences.zh: 拔安豐，破襄陽、安陸。

translations.literal: He captured Anfeng and defeated Xiangyang and Anlu.
translations.idiomatic: He took Anfeng and defeated the forces at Xiangyang and Anlu.

sentences.zh: 取淮東，克舊館，降士誠將硃暹，遂取湖州。

translations.literal: He took Huaidong, captured Jiuguan, induced the surrender of Shicheng's general Zhu Xian, and then took Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He secured Huaidong, captured Jiuguan, accepted the surrender of Shicheng's general Zhu Xian, and then took Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 遷驍騎右衛親軍指揮使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Commander of the Personal Guard of the Valiant Cavalry Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to commander of the personal guard of the Valiant Cavalry Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 進圍平江，弼軍盤門。

translations.literal: He advanced to besiege Pingjiang; Bi's army held Pan Gate.
translations.idiomatic: He advanced to besiege Pingjiang, with Bi's army posted at Pan Gate.

sentences.zh: 士誠親帥銳士突圍，出西門搏戰，將奔常遇春軍。

translations.literal: Shicheng personally led elite troops in a breakout, went out the west gate to fight, and was about to flee toward Chang Yuchun's army.
translations.idiomatic: Shicheng personally led elite troops in a breakout, fought his way out the west gate, and was about to flee toward Chang Yuchun's camp.

sentences.zh: 遇春分兵北濠，截其後，而別遣兵與戰。

translations.literal: Yuchun divided his troops at the northern moat to cut off their rear while sending other forces to engage them.
translations.idiomatic: Yuchun divided his troops at the northern moat to cut off their retreat while sending other forces to engage them.

sentences.zh: 士誠軍殊死斗。

translations.literal: Shicheng's army fought to the death.
translations.idiomatic: Shicheng's army fought with desperate fury.

sentences.zh: 遇春拊弼臂曰：「軍中皆稱爾健將，能為我取此乎？

translations.literal: Yuchun clapped Bi on the arm and said, "The whole army calls you a stalwart commander—can you take this for me?
translations.idiomatic: Yuchun clapped Bi on the arm and said, "The whole army calls you a stalwart commander. Can you break them for me?

sentences.zh: 」弼應曰：「諾。

translations.literal: " Bi answered, "Yes.
translations.idiomatic: " Bi answered, "I will."

sentences.zh: 」馳騎，揮雙刀奮擊。

translations.literal: " He spurred his horse, wielded his paired sabers, and charged fiercely.
translations.idiomatic: He spurred his horse forward and charged, swinging his paired sabers.

sentences.zh: 敵小卻。

translations.literal: The enemy fell back slightly.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy gave ground.

sentences.zh: 遇春帥眾乘之，吳兵大敗，人馬溺死沙盆潭者甚眾。

translations.literal: Yuchun led the mass to press the advantage; the Wu army was utterly defeated, and very many men and horses drowned in Shapen Pool.
translations.idiomatic: Yuchun led the main force in pursuit. The Wu army was routed, and a great many men and horses drowned in Shapen Pool.

sentences.zh: 士誠馬逸墮水，幾不救，肩輿入城，自是不敢復出。

translations.literal: Shicheng's horse bolted and he fell into the water, nearly not saved; he was carried into the city in a litter and from then dared not come out again.
translations.idiomatic: Shicheng's horse bolted and threw him into the water; he was barely rescued. He was carried back into the city in a litter and never dared come out again.

sentences.zh: 吳平，賞賚甚厚。

translations.literal: When Wu was pacified, his rewards were very generous.
translations.idiomatic: When Wu was pacified, he was rewarded very generously.

sentences.zh: 從大軍征中原，下山東，略定河南北，遂取元都。

translations.literal: He followed the great army in the campaign against the Central Plains, descended into Shandong, pacified northern Henan, and then took the Yuan capital.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the main army in the campaign against the Central Plains, swept through Shandong, secured northern Henan, and then took the Yuan capital.

sentences.zh: 克山西，走擴廓。

translations.literal: He captured Shanxi and drove off Köke Temür.
translations.idiomatic: He took Shanxi and drove off Köke Temür.

sentences.zh: 自河中渡河，克陝西，進征察罕腦兒，師還。

translations.literal: From Hezhong he crossed the river, captured Shaanxi, advanced to campaign at Chaghan Nur, and the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: From Hezhong he crossed the Yellow River, took Shaanxi, advanced to Chaghan Nur, and then returned with the army.

sentences.zh: 洪武三年，授大都督府僉事，世襲指揮使。

translations.literal: In the third year of Hongwu he was appointed Associate Director of the Chief Military Commission with hereditary succession as Commander.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Hongwu he was appointed associate director of the chief military commission, with hereditary succession as commander.

sentences.zh: 十一年副西平侯沐英征西番，降朵甘諸酋及洮州十八族，殺獲甚眾。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he served as deputy to the Marquis of Xiping Mu Ying in the campaign against the Western Barbarians, inducing the surrender of the chiefs of Duogan and the Eighteen Clans of Taozhou; kills and captures were very numerous.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he served under the Marquis of Xiping Mu Ying in the campaign against the western tribes, accepting the surrender of the chiefs of Duogan and the eighteen clans of Taozhou. The slaughter and captures were immense.

sentences.zh: 論功，封定遠侯，食祿二千石。

translations.literal: When merit was assessed he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Dingyuan with an income of two thousand piculs of grain.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Dingyuan with an income of 2,000 piculs of grain.

sentences.zh: 十四年從傅友德征雲南，至大理，土酋段世扼龍尾關。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he followed Fu Youde in the campaign against Yunnan; reaching Dali, the tribal chief Duan Shi held Longwei Pass.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he followed Fu Youde into Yunnan. At Dali the tribal chief Duan Shi held Longwei Pass.

sentences.zh: 弼以兵由洱水趨上關，與沐英兵夾擊之，拔其城，擒段世，鶴慶、麗江諸郡以次悉平。

translations.literal: Bi led troops along the Er River toward Shangguan and, with Mu Ying's forces attacking from both sides, captured the city and seized Duan Shi; the prefectures of Heqing, Lijiang, and others were then all pacified in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Bi led troops along the Er River toward Shangguan and, attacking from both sides with Mu Ying's forces, took the city and captured Duan Shi. The prefectures of Heqing, Lijiang, and the rest were then pacified in succession.

sentences.zh: 加祿五百石，予世券。

translations.literal: His income was increased by five hundred piculs of grain and he was granted a hereditary patent.
translations.idiomatic: His income was increased by 500 piculs of grain and he was granted a hereditary patent of nobility.

sentences.zh: 二十年，以副將軍從馮勝北伐，降納哈出。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, as vice-general he followed Feng Sheng on the northern campaign and induced the surrender of Naghachu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he served as vice-general under Feng Sheng on the northern campaign and accepted the surrender of Naghachu.

sentences.zh: 明年復以副將軍從藍玉出塞。

translations.literal: The next year he again served as vice-general under Lan Yu beyond the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he again served as vice-general under Lan Yu on an expedition beyond the frontier.

sentences.zh: 深入不見敵，玉欲引還。

translations.literal: Having advanced deep without sighting the enemy, Yu wished to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: After advancing deep into the steppe without finding the enemy, Yu wanted to turn back.

sentences.zh: 弼持不可，玉從之。

translations.literal: Bi held that this could not be done, and Yu followed his counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Bi insisted they could not withdraw yet, and Yu agreed.

sentences.zh: 進至捕魚兒海，以弼為前鋒，直薄敵營。

translations.literal: Advancing to Buyur Lake, he made Bi the vanguard to press straight upon the enemy camp.
translations.idiomatic: When they reached Buyur Lake, Yu made Bi the vanguard and sent him straight at the enemy camp.

sentences.zh: 走元嗣主脫古思帖木兒，盡獲其輜重，語在玉傳。

translations.literal: The Yuan heir-apparent Tögüs Temür fled; all his baggage was captured—the account is in Yu's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan heir Tögüs Temür fled, and all his baggage was captured. The full account is given in Yu's biography.

sentences.zh: 二十三年奉詔還鄉。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was ordered by edict to return to his home district.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was ordered by edict to return home.

sentences.zh: 二十五年從馮勝、傅友德練軍山西、河南。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fifth year he joined Feng Sheng and Fu Youde in training troops in Shanxi and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fifth year he joined Feng Sheng and Fu Youde in training troops in Shanxi and Henan.

sentences.zh: 明年同召還，先後賜死。

translations.literal: The next year both were summoned back and, one after the other, granted death.
translations.idiomatic: The following year both were recalled and, in succession, ordered to take their own lives.

sentences.zh: 爵除。

translations.literal: His title was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: His title was abolished.

sentences.zh: 弼子六人，女為楚王妃。

translations.literal: Bi had six sons; a daughter became consort to the Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Bi had six sons, and one daughter became consort to the Prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 藍玉，定遠人。

translations.literal: Lan Yu was a man of Dingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Lan Yu was a native of Dingyuan.

sentences.zh: 開平王常遇春婦弟也。

translations.literal: He was the younger brother of the wife of the Prince of Kaiping, Chang Yuchun.
translations.idiomatic: He was the younger brother of Chang Yuchun's wife; Chang Yuchun held the title Prince of Kaiping.

sentences.zh: 初隸遇春帳下，臨敵勇敢，所向皆捷。

translations.literal: At first he served under Yuchun's command; facing the enemy he was brave, and wherever he went he was victorious.
translations.idiomatic: He first served under Yuchun's command. In battle he was fearless, and wherever he fought he prevailed.

sentences.zh: 遇春數稱於太祖，由管軍鎮撫積功至大都督府僉事。

translations.literal: Yuchun repeatedly praised him to the Taizu; through accumulated merit from troop command and pacification commissions he rose to Associate Director of the Chief Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Yuchun repeatedly commended him to the Taizu, and through accumulated merit in command and pacification posts he rose to associate director of the chief military commission.

sentences.zh: 洪武四年，從傅友德伐蜀，克綿州。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Hongwu he followed Fu Youde in the attack on Shu and captured Mianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Hongwu he followed Fu Youde in the campaign against Shu and captured Mianzhou.

sentences.zh: 五年從徐達北征，先出雁門，敗元兵於亂山，再敗之於土剌河。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he followed Xu Da on the northern campaign, going out first through Yanmen, defeating Yuan troops at Luan Mountain, and defeating them again at the Tula River.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he followed Xu Da on the northern campaign, advancing first through Yanmen Pass, defeating Yuan forces at Luan Mountain, and defeating them again on the Tula River.

sentences.zh: 七年帥兵拔興和，獲其國公帖里密赤等五十九人。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he commanded troops to capture Xinghe and seized fifty-nine men including their State Duke Temürichi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he led troops to capture Xinghe and took fifty-nine prisoners including the state duke Temürichi.

sentences.zh: 十一年同西平侯沐英討西番，擒其酋三副使，斬獲千計。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he joined the Marquis of Xiping Mu Ying in suppressing the Western Barbarians, capturing their chief the Third Vice-Commissioner; beheadings and captures numbered in the thousands.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he joined the Marquis of Xiping Mu Ying in the campaign against the western tribes, capturing their chief the third vice-commissioner. Beheadings and captures numbered in the thousands.

sentences.zh: 明年，師還。

translations.literal: The next year the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the army returned.

sentences.zh: 封永昌侯，食祿二千五百石，予世券。

translations.literal: He was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yongchang with an income of two thousand five hundred piculs of grain and granted a hereditary patent.
translations.idiomatic: He was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yongchang with an income of 2,500 piculs of grain and granted a hereditary patent of nobility.

sentences.zh: 十四年，以征南左副將軍從潁川侯傅友德征雲南，擒元平章達里麻於曲靖，梁王走死，滇地悉平。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, as Left Vice-General of the Southern Expedition he followed the Marquis of Yingchuan Fu Youde in the campaign against Yunnan, capturing the Yuan Pacification Commissioner Darmi at Qujing; the Prince of Liang fled and died, and the entire Dian region was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year, as left vice-general of the southern expedition, he followed the Marquis of Yingchuan Fu Youde into Yunnan. He captured the Yuan pacification commissioner Darmi at Qujing; the Prince of Liang fled and died, and all of Yunnan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 玉功為多，益祿五百石。

translations.literal: Yu's merit was the greatest; his income was increased by five hundred piculs of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Yu's contributions were the greatest, and his income was increased by 500 piculs of grain.

sentences.zh: 冊其女為蜀王妃。

translations.literal: His daughter was ennobled as consort to the Prince of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: His daughter was made consort to the Prince of Shu.

sentences.zh: 二十年，以征虜左副將軍從大將軍馮勝征納哈出，次通州。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, as Left Vice-General of the Expedition against the Barbarians he followed the Great General Feng Sheng in the campaign against Naghachu and halted at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year, as left vice-general of the expedition against the barbarians, he followed the great general Feng Sheng against Naghachu and encamped at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 聞元兵有屯慶州者，玉乘大雪，帥輕騎襲破之，殺平章果來，擒其子不蘭溪還。

translations.literal: Hearing that Yuan troops were encamped at Qingzhou, Yu took advantage of heavy snow to lead light cavalry in a surprise attack, killing the Pacification Commissioner Guolai and capturing his son Bulanxi on the return.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that Yuan troops were encamped at Qingzhou, Yu took advantage of a heavy snowfall to lead light cavalry in a surprise attack, killing the pacification commissioner Guolai and capturing his son Bulanxi.

sentences.zh: 會大軍進至金山，納哈出遣使詣大將軍營納欸，玉往受降。

translations.literal: When the great army advanced to Jinshan, Naghachu sent envoys to the great general's camp to submit; Yu went to accept the surrender.
translations.idiomatic: When the main army reached Jinshan, Naghachu sent envoys to Feng Sheng's camp to submit. Yu went to accept the surrender.

sentences.zh: 納哈出以數百騎至，玉大喜，飲以酒。

translations.literal: Naghachu came with several hundred horsemen; Yu was greatly pleased and gave him wine to drink.
translations.idiomatic: Naghachu arrived with several hundred horsemen. Yu was delighted and offered him wine.

sentences.zh: 納哈出酌酒酬玉，玉解衣衣之，曰：「請服此而飲。

translations.literal: Naghachu poured wine in return to Yu; Yu removed his garment and clothed him in it, saying, "Please put this on and then drink.
translations.idiomatic: Naghachu poured wine in return. Yu removed his own garment and offered it to him, saying, "Please put this on and then drink.

sentences.zh: 」納哈出不肯服，玉亦不飲。

translations.literal: " Naghachu refused to put it on, and Yu also would not drink.
translations.idiomatic: " Naghachu refused to put it on, and Yu would not drink either.

sentences.zh: 爭讓久之，納哈出覆酒於地，顧其下咄咄語，將脫去。

translations.literal: After long contention and yielding, Naghachu overturned his wine on the ground, turned to his followers with angry words, and was about to break away.
translations.idiomatic: After a long exchange of courtesies, Naghachu overturned his wine on the ground, turned to his men with angry words, and was about to leave.

sentences.zh: 鄭國公常茂在坐，直前砍傷之，都督耿忠擁以見勝。

translations.literal: Duke of Zheng Chang Mao was present; he stepped forward and hacked him, wounding him; the Commander Geng Zhong seized and escorted him to see Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Zheng, Chang Mao, was present. He stepped forward and struck Naghachu, wounding him. The commander Geng Zhong seized him and brought him before Feng Sheng.

sentences.zh: 其眾驚潰，遣降將觀童諭降之。

translations.literal: His followers were startled and scattered; he sent the surrendered general Guan Tong to instruct them to submit.
translations.idiomatic: His followers panicked and scattered. Yu sent the surrendered general Guan Tong to persuade them to submit.

sentences.zh: 還至亦迷河，悉降其餘眾。

translations.literal: On the return to the Yimi River, the remainder of his forces all surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march to the Yimi River, the rest of his forces all surrendered.

sentences.zh: 會馮勝有罪，收大將軍印，命玉行總兵官事，尋即軍中拜玉為大將軍，移屯薊州。

translations.literal: When Feng Sheng was found guilty, the great general's seal was taken back; Yu was ordered to perform the duties of commander-in-chief, and soon thereafter in the army Yu was appointed Great General and moved his camp to Jizhou.
translations.idiomatic: When Feng Sheng was found guilty, his seal as great general was revoked. Yu was ordered to act as commander-in-chief, and soon afterward was appointed great general in the field and moved his camp to Jizhou.

sentences.zh: 時順帝孫脫古思帖木兒嗣立，擾塞上。

translations.literal: At that time the Shundi emperor's grandson Tögüs Temür had succeeded to the throne and was harassing the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the late emperor's grandson Tögüs Temür had succeeded to the Yuan throne and was raiding the frontier.

sentences.zh: 二十一年三月，命玉帥師十五萬征之。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-first year he was ordered to command an army of one hundred fifty thousand to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the twenty-first year he was ordered to lead an army of 150,000 against him.

sentences.zh: 出大寧，至慶州，諜知元主在捕魚兒海，間道兼程進至百眼井。

translations.literal: Setting out from Daning and reaching Qingzhou, spies reported that the Yuan ruler was at Buyur Lake; by a side route he pressed day and night to reach Baiyan Well.
translations.idiomatic: Setting out from Daning and reaching Qingzhou, his scouts learned that the Yuan ruler was at Buyur Lake. Taking a side route, he pressed forward day and night to Baiyan Well.

sentences.zh: 去海四十里，不見敵，欲引還。

translations.literal: Forty li from the lake, with no enemy in sight, he wished to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Forty li from the lake, with no enemy in sight, he wanted to turn back.

sentences.zh: 定遠侯王弼曰：「吾輩提十余萬眾，深入漠北，無所得，遽班師，何以覆命？

translations.literal: The Marquis of Dingyuan Wang Bi said, "We have led more than one hundred thousand men deep into the northern desert without gaining anything—if we withdraw abruptly, how can we answer for it?
translations.idiomatic: The Marquis of Dingyuan Wang Bi said, "We have led more than a hundred thousand men deep into the northern desert without gaining anything. If we withdraw now, how can we answer to the throne?

sentences.zh: 」玉曰：「然。

translations.literal: " Yu said, "It is so.
translations.idiomatic: " Yu said, "You are right.

sentences.zh: 」令軍士穴地而爨，毋見煙火。

translations.literal: " He ordered the soldiers to dig pits in the ground to cook and not let smoke or fire be seen.
translations.idiomatic: " He ordered the soldiers to cook in sunken pits so that no smoke or flame would be visible.

sentences.zh: 乘夜至海南，敵營尚在海東北八十余里。

translations.literal: Traveling by night they reached the south of the lake; the enemy camp was still more than eighty li to the northeast of the lake.
translations.idiomatic: Marching by night they reached the south shore of the lake. The enemy camp was still more than eighty li to the northeast.

sentences.zh: 玉令弼為前鋒，疾馳薄其營。

translations.literal: Yu ordered Bi as vanguard to gallop swiftly and press upon their camp.
translations.idiomatic: Yu made Bi the vanguard and sent him galloping straight at the enemy camp.

sentences.zh: 敵謂我軍乏水草，不能深入，不設備。

translations.literal: The enemy thought our army lacked water and fodder and could not penetrate deep, and made no preparations.
translations.idiomatic: The enemy assumed our army lacked water and fodder and could not penetrate so far, and made no preparations.

sentences.zh: 又大風揚沙，晝晦。

translations.literal: Moreover a great wind raised sand, and the day was dark.
translations.idiomatic: A great wind raised sand and blotted out the daylight.

sentences.zh: 軍行，敵無所覺。

translations.literal: As the army marched, the enemy perceived nothing.
translations.idiomatic: The army advanced without the enemy noticing.

sentences.zh: 猝至前，大驚。

translations.literal: Suddenly arriving before them, they were greatly alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: When the Ming forces suddenly appeared before them, the enemy was thrown into panic.

sentences.zh: 迎戰，敗之。

translations.literal: They met the attack and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: They met the attack but were defeated.

sentences.zh: 殺太尉蠻子等，降其眾。

translations.literal: The Grand Preceptor Manzi and others were killed, and their followers surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: The grand preceptor Manzi and others were killed, and their followers surrendered.

sentences.zh: 元主與太子天保奴數十騎遁去。

translations.literal: The Yuan ruler and the crown prince Tianbaonu fled with several dozen horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan ruler and the crown prince Tianbaonu fled with only a few dozen horsemen.

sentences.zh: 玉以精騎追之，不及。

translations.literal: Yu with elite cavalry pursued them but did not overtake them.
translations.idiomatic: Yu sent elite cavalry in pursuit but could not overtake them.

sentences.zh: 獲其次子地保奴、妃、公主以下百余人。

translations.literal: He captured his second son Dibaonu, the consort, princesses, and more than one hundred persons below them.
translations.idiomatic: He captured the Yuan ruler's second son Dibaonu, along with the consort, princesses, and more than a hundred members of the court.

sentences.zh: 又追獲吳王朵兒只、代王達里麻及平章以下官屬三千人，男女七萬七千余人，並寶璽、符敕金牌、金銀印諸物，馬駝牛羊十五萬余。

translations.literal: He further pursued and captured the Prince of Wu Dorji, the Prince of Dai Darmi, and three thousand officials including Pacification Commissioners and below, seventy-seven thousand men and women, together with the imperial seal, tallies, edicts, gold plaques, gold and silver seals, and other objects, and more than one hundred fifty thousand horses, camels, cattle, and sheep.
translations.idiomatic: In further pursuit he captured the Prince of Wu Dorji, the Prince of Dai Darmi, and three thousand officials down to the rank of pacification commissioner, along with 77,000 men and women. He also seized the imperial seal, tallies, edicts, gold plaques, gold and silver seals, and more than 150,000 horses, camels, cattle, and sheep.

sentences.zh: 焚其甲仗蓄積無算。

translations.literal: Their armor, weapons, and stored supplies burned were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: Their armor, weapons, and stored supplies burned were beyond reckoning.

sentences.zh: 奏捷京師，帝大喜，賜敕褒勞，比之衛青、李靖。

translations.literal: Reporting victory to the capital, the emperor was greatly pleased, bestowed an edict of praise and reward, and compared him to Wei Qing and Li Jing.
translations.idiomatic: When the victory was reported to the capital, the emperor was overjoyed. He issued an edict of praise and compared Yu to Wei Qing and Li Jing.

sentences.zh: 又破哈剌章營，獲人畜六萬。

translations.literal: He again broke the camp at Qarčang and captured sixty thousand persons and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: He also broke the camp at Qarčang and took 60,000 captives and livestock.

sentences.zh: 師還，進涼國公。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was advanced to Duke of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return he was promoted to Duke of Liang.

sentences.zh: 明年命督修四川城池。

translations.literal: The next year he was ordered to supervise the repair of the walled cities of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he was ordered to supervise repairs to the walled cities of Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，施南、忠建二宣撫司蠻叛，命玉討平之。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the barbarians of the two Pacification Commissions of Shinan and Zhongjian rebelled; Yu was ordered to suppress and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year the tribal peoples of the Shinan and Zhongjian pacification commissions rebelled, and Yu was ordered to suppress them.

sentences.zh: 又平都勻，安撫司散毛諸洞，益祿五百石，詔還鄉。

translations.literal: He again pacified Duyun and the caves of Sanmao under the Pacification Commission, his income was increased by five hundred piculs of grain, and an edict ordered him to return to his home district.
translations.idiomatic: He also pacified Duyun and the cave districts of Sanmao under the pacification commission. His income was increased by 500 piculs of grain, and he was ordered home by edict.

sentences.zh: 二十四年命玉理蘭州、庄浪等七衛兵，以追逃寇祁者孫，遂略西番罕東之地。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year Yu was ordered to administer the troops of the seven guards including Lanzhou and Zhuanglang to pursue the fugitive bandit Qizhe's grandson, and thereby overran the lands of the Western Barbarians in Hantong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year Yu was ordered to administer the troops of seven guards including Lanzhou and Zhuanglang in pursuit of the fugitive bandit Qizhe's grandson, and in doing so overran the Hantong region of the western tribes.

sentences.zh: 土酋哈昝等遁去。

translations.literal: The tribal chiefs including Ha Zan fled.
translations.idiomatic: The tribal chiefs including Ha Zan fled.

sentences.zh: 會建昌指揮使月魯帖木兒叛，詔移兵討之。

translations.literal: When the Jianchang Commander Yue'er Temür rebelled, an edict ordered the transfer of troops to suppress him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jianchang commander Yue'er Temür rebelled, an edict ordered Yu to move his troops against him.

sentences.zh: 至則都指揮瞿能等已大破其眾，月魯走柏興州。

translations.literal: When he arrived, the Regional Commander Qu Neng and others had already routed his forces; Yue'er fled to Baixing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: By the time he arrived, the regional commander Qu Neng and others had already routed the rebel forces. Yue'er fled to Baixing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 玉遣百戶毛海誘縛其父子，送京師誅之，而盡降其眾，因請增置屯衛。

translations.literal: Yu sent the Centurion Mao Hai to lure and bind father and son, sent them to the capital for execution, and induced the complete surrender of their followers; he then requested the addition of garrison guards.
translations.idiomatic: Yu sent the centurion Mao Hai to lure and capture father and son, sent them to the capital for execution, and accepted the surrender of all their followers. He then requested additional garrison posts.

sentences.zh: 報可。

translations.literal: The reply approved it.
translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 復請籍民為兵，討朵甘、百夷。

translations.literal: He again requested to register the people as soldiers to campaign against Duogan and the Hundred Yi.
translations.idiomatic: He again asked to register the local population as soldiers for a campaign against Duogan and the various Yi peoples.

sentences.zh: 詔不許，遂班師。

translations.literal: An edict did not permit it, and he then withdrew the army.
translations.idiomatic: The court refused permission, and he withdrew the army.

sentences.zh: 玉長身赬面，饒勇略，有大將才。

translations.literal: Yu was tall in stature with a ruddy face, abounding in courage and stratagem, and possessed the talent of a great commander.
translations.idiomatic: Yu was tall and ruddy-faced, full of courage and stratagem, and possessed the talent of a great commander.

sentences.zh: 中山、開平既沒，數總大軍，多立功。

translations.literal: After the Zhongshan and Kaiping princes had died, he repeatedly commanded great armies and achieved many merits.
translations.idiomatic: After the deaths of Xu Da and Chang Yuchun, Yu repeatedly commanded large armies and won many victories.

sentences.zh: 太祖遇之厚。

translations.literal: The Taizu treated him generously.
translations.idiomatic: The Taizu treated him with exceptional favor.

sentences.zh: 浸驕蹇自恣，多蓄庄奴、假子，乘勢暴橫。

translations.literal: Gradually he became arrogant and willful, kept many estate slaves and adopted sons, and relying on his power acted with violent insolence.
translations.idiomatic: He gradually grew arrogant and willful, kept many estate slaves and adopted sons, and used his power to act with violent insolence.

sentences.zh: 嘗佔東昌民田，御史按問，玉怒，逐御史。

translations.literal: He once seized the farmland of commoners in Dongchang; when a censor investigated, Yu was angry and drove the censor away.
translations.idiomatic: He once seized commoners' farmland in Dongchang. When a censor investigated, Yu flew into a rage and drove the censor away.

sentences.zh: 北征還，夜扣喜峰關。

translations.literal: Returning from the northern campaign, he knocked at Xifeng Pass by night.
translations.idiomatic: On his return from the northern campaign he arrived at Xifeng Pass by night.

sentences.zh: 關吏不時納，縱兵毀關入。

translations.literal: The pass officials did not admit him promptly; he unleashed his troops to destroy the pass and enter.
translations.idiomatic: The gate officers did not admit him promptly, so he unleashed his troops, broke through the pass, and entered.

sentences.zh: 帝聞之不樂。

translations.literal: When the emperor heard of it he was displeased.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor heard of this he was displeased.

sentences.zh: 又人言其私元主妃，妃慚自經死，帝切責玉。

translations.literal: Moreover people said he had violated the Yuan ruler's consort; the consort, ashamed, hanged herself, and the emperor sternly rebuked Yu.
translations.idiomatic: There were also reports that he had violated the Yuan ruler's consort, who hanged herself in shame. The emperor sternly rebuked Yu.

sentences.zh: 初，帝欲封玉梁國公，以過改為涼，仍鐫其過於券。

translations.literal: At first the emperor wished to enfeoff Yu as Duke of Liang, but because of his offenses changed it to Liang and still carved his offenses upon the patent.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor had originally intended to enfeoff Yu as Duke of Liang, but because of his offenses changed the title to Liang and had his misdeeds inscribed on the patent of nobility.

sentences.zh: 玉猶不悛，侍宴語傲慢。

translations.literal: Yu still did not reform; at banquets his speech was arrogant.
translations.idiomatic: Yu still did not reform. At court banquets his speech was arrogant.

sentences.zh: 在軍擅黜陟將校，進止自專，帝數譙讓。

translations.literal: In the army he arbitrarily dismissed and promoted officers; advances and halts were at his sole discretion, and the emperor repeatedly reproached him.
translations.idiomatic: In the field he dismissed and promoted officers on his own authority and directed movements as he pleased. The emperor rebuked him repeatedly.

sentences.zh: 西征還，命為太子太傅。

translations.literal: On his return from the western campaign he was appointed Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: On his return from the western campaign he was appointed grand tutor to the heir apparent.

sentences.zh: 玉不樂居宋、潁兩公下，曰：「我不堪太師耶！

translations.literal: Yu was displeased to rank below the two dukes of Song and Ying and said, "Am I unfit to be Grand Preceptor!
translations.idiomatic: Yu resented ranking below the dukes of Song and Ying and said, "Am I unfit to be grand preceptor?

sentences.zh: 」比奏事多不聽，益怏怏。

translations.literal: " When he came to report affairs many were not heeded, and he grew still more resentful.
translations.idiomatic: " When he came to court, many of his proposals went unheeded, and he grew still more resentful.

sentences.zh: 二十六年二月，錦衣衛指揮蔣瓛告玉謀反，下吏鞫訊。

translations.literal: In the second month of the twenty-sixth year the Brocade-Coated Guard Commander Jiang Huan reported that Yu plotted rebellion; he was handed to officials for interrogation.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the twenty-sixth year the brocade-coated guard commander Jiang Huan reported that Yu was plotting rebellion. Yu was handed over for interrogation.

sentences.zh: 獄辭云：「玉同景川侯曹震、鶴慶侯張翼、舳艫侯硃壽、東莞伯何榮及吏部尚書詹徽、戶部侍郎傅友文等謀為變，將伺帝出耤田舉事。

translations.literal: The prison confession stated, "Yu together with the Marquis of Jingchuan Cao Zhen, the Marquis of Heqing Zhang Yi, the Marquis of Scullion Zhu Shou, the Earl of Dongguan He Rong, and the Ministers of Personnel Zhan Hui and Revenue Fu Youwen and others plotted a revolt, intending to wait until the emperor went out to the plowing ceremony to raise the affair.
translations.idiomatic: The confession stated that Yu, together with the Marquis of Jingchuan Cao Zhen, the Marquis of Heqing Zhang Yi, the Marquis of Scullion Zhu Shou, the Earl of Dongguan He Rong, the minister of personnel Zhan Hui, the vice minister of revenue Fu Youwen, and others, plotted a revolt and intended to strike when the emperor went out for the plowing ceremony.

sentences.zh: 」獄具，族誅之。

translations.literal: " When the case was complete, the clans were exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: " When the case was complete, Yu and his associates were executed to the third degree.

sentences.zh: 列侯以下坐黨夷滅者不可勝數。

translations.literal: Marquises and below who were punished by association and exterminated were beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: The marquises and lesser nobles punished by association were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 手詔佈告天下，條列爰書為《逆臣錄》。

translations.literal: A hand-edict was promulgated throughout the realm, itemizing the written confession as the Record of Rebellious Ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor issued a hand-edict to the realm, publishing the written confession as the Record of Rebellious Ministers.

sentences.zh: 至九月，乃下詔曰：「藍賊為亂，謀泄，族誅者萬五千人。

translations.literal: By the ninth month an edict was then issued, saying, "The bandit Lan raised disorder; when the plot was exposed, those exterminated by clan numbered fifteen thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month an edict was issued: "The traitor Lan raised a rebellion. When the plot was exposed, fifteen thousand people were executed by association.

sentences.zh: 自今胡黨、藍黨概赦不問。

translations.literal: From now on the Hu faction and the Lan faction are altogether pardoned and not to be pursued.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth members of the Hu and Lan factions are altogether pardoned and will not be pursued.

sentences.zh: 」胡謂丞相惟庸也。

translations.literal: " Hu refers to the Chancellor Hu Weiyong.
translations.idiomatic: " "Hu" refers to the chancellor Hu Weiyong.

sentences.zh: 於是元功宿將相繼盡矣。

translations.literal: Thus the founding merit-holders and veteran generals were in succession exhausted.
translations.idiomatic: With this, the founding merit-holders and veteran generals were successively wiped out.

sentences.zh: 凡列名《逆臣錄》者，一公、十三侯、二伯。

translations.literal: All those listed by name in the Record of Rebellious Ministers numbered one duke, thirteen marquises, and two earls.
translations.idiomatic: Those named in the Record of Rebellious Ministers numbered one duke, thirteen marquises, and two earls.

sentences.zh: 葉升前坐事誅，胡玉等諸小侯皆別見。

translations.literal: Ye Sheng had earlier been executed for another matter; the lesser marquises such as Hu Yu are recorded separately.
translations.idiomatic: Ye Sheng had already been executed on other charges; the lesser marquises such as Hu Yu are recorded elsewhere.

sentences.zh: 其曹震、張翼、張溫、陳桓、硃壽、曹興六侯，附著左方。

translations.literal: The six marquises Cao Zhen, Zhang Yi, Zhang Wen, Chen Huan, Zhu Shou, and Cao Xing are appended on the left.
translations.idiomatic: The six marquises Cao Zhen, Zhang Yi, Zhang Wen, Chen Huan, Zhu Shou, and Cao Xing are appended below.

sentences.zh: 曹震，濠人。

translations.literal: Cao Zhen was a man of Hao.
translations.idiomatic: Cao Zhen was a native of Hao.

sentences.zh: 從太祖起兵，累官指揮使。

translations.literal: He followed the Taizu in raising the army and through successive offices reached Commander.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the Taizu in raising the army and rose through successive posts to commander.

sentences.zh: 洪武十二年，以征西番功封景川侯，祿二千石。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Hongwu, for merit in the campaign against the Western Barbarians he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jingchuan with an income of two thousand piculs of grain.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year of Hongwu, for his merit in the campaign against the western tribes, he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Jingchuan with an income of 2,000 piculs of grain.

sentences.zh: 從藍玉征雲南，分道取臨安諸路，至威楚，降元平章閻乃馬歹等。

translations.literal: He followed Lan Yu in the campaign against Yunnan, took the routes of Lin'an by separate columns, reached Weichu, and induced the surrender of the Yuan Pacification Commissioner Yanaimadai and others.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Lan Yu into Yunnan, took the Lin'an routes by separate columns, reached Weichu, and accepted the surrender of the Yuan pacification commissioner Yanaimadai and others.

sentences.zh: 雲南平，因請討容美、散毛諸洞蠻及西番朵甘、思曩日諸族。

translations.literal: When Yunnan was pacified he requested to campaign against the cave barbarians of Rongmei, Sanmao, and others and the Western Barbarian peoples of Duogan, Sinangri, and others.
translations.idiomatic: After Yunnan was pacified he asked permission to campaign against the cave peoples of Rongmei and Sanmao and against the western tribes of Duogan and Sinangri.

sentences.zh: 詔不許。

translations.literal: An edict did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The court refused permission.

sentences.zh: 又請以貴州、四川二都司所易番馬，分給陝西、河南將士。

translations.literal: He again requested that the barbarian horses exchanged by the two regional commands of Guizhou and Sichuan be distributed to the officers and soldiers of Shaanxi and Henan.
translations.idiomatic: He also asked that the tribal horses obtained by the Guizhou and Sichuan regional commands be distributed to the troops of Shaanxi and Henan.

sentences.zh: 又言：「四川至建昌驛，道經大渡河，往來者多死瘴癘。

translations.literal: He also stated, "The courier route from Sichuan to Jianchang passes the Dadu River, and many of those traveling back and forth die of miasmic pestilence.
translations.idiomatic: He also reported: "The courier route from Sichuan to Jianchang passes the Dadu River, and many travelers die of miasmic disease there.

sentences.zh: 詢父老，自眉州峨眉至建昌，有古驛道，平易無瘴毒，已令軍民修治。

translations.literal: Inquiring of the elders, from Meizhou Emei to Jianchang there is an ancient courier road, level and easy without miasmic poison; he had already ordered soldiers and civilians to repair it.
translations.idiomatic: According to local elders, an ancient courier road runs from Emei in Meizhou to Jianchang. It is level and free of miasmic disease, and he had already ordered troops and civilians to repair it.

sentences.zh: 請以瀘州至建昌驛馬，移置峨眉新驛。

translations.literal: He requested that the relay horses from Luzhou to Jianchang be moved to the new station at Emei.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that the relay horses on the Luzhou-Jianchang route be moved to the new station at Emei.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " This was followed.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，與靖寧侯葉升分道討平東川叛蠻，俘獲五千余人。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, together with the Marquis of Jingning Ye Sheng by separate routes he suppressed and pacified the rebellious barbarians of Dongchuan, capturing more than five thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year he and the Marquis of Jingning Ye Sheng suppressed the Dongchuan rebels by separate routes and took more than five thousand captives.

sentences.zh: 尋覆命理四川軍務，同藍玉核征南軍士。

translations.literal: Soon he was again ordered to oversee Sichuan military affairs and together with Lan Yu audited the southern campaign troops.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered again to oversee military affairs in Sichuan and, together with Lan Yu, to audit the southern campaign forces.

sentences.zh: 會永寧宣慰司言，所轄地有百九十灘，其八十余灘道梗不利。

translations.literal: When the Yongning Pacification Commission reported that within its jurisdiction were one hundred ninety rapids, of which more than eighty had obstructed routes that were disadvantageous.
translations.idiomatic: When the Yongning pacification commission reported that its territory contained 190 rapids, more than 80 of which obstructed transport routes.

sentences.zh: 詔震疏治之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zhen to dredge and repair them.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Zhen to dredge and clear them.

sentences.zh: 震至瀘州按視，有支河通永寧，乃鑿石削崖，令深廣以通漕運。

translations.literal: Zhen reached Luzhou to inspect; there was a branch river connecting to Yongning, and he cut stone and trimmed cliffs to make the channel deep and broad for grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen inspected the route at Luzhou and found a branch river connecting to Yongning. He cut through rock and trimmed the cliffs to deepen and widen the channel for grain transport.

sentences.zh: 又辟陸路，作驛舍、郵亭，駕橋立棧。

translations.literal: He also opened a land route, built relay lodges and postal pavilions, erected bridges, and set up plank roads.
translations.idiomatic: He also opened a land route, built relay lodges and postal stations, erected bridges, and laid plank roads.

sentences.zh: 自茂州，一道至松潘，一道至貴州，以達保寧。

translations.literal: From Maozhou one route reached Songpan and another reached Guizhou to connect to Baoning.
translations.idiomatic: From Maozhou one route reached Songpan and another reached Guizhou, linking through to Baoning.

sentences.zh: 先是行人許穆言：「松州地磽瘠，不宜屯種。

translations.literal: Earlier the traveling official Xu Mu had stated, "The land of Songzhou is stony and barren and unsuitable for garrison farming.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier the traveling official Xu Mu had argued that Songzhou's land was stony and barren and unsuitable for garrison farming.

sentences.zh: 戍卒三千，糧運不給，請移戍茂州，俾就近屯田。

translations.literal: Three thousand garrison soldiers could not be supplied with grain transport; he requested moving the garrison to Maozhou so they could farm nearby.
translations.idiomatic: The three thousand garrison troops could not be supplied by grain transport. He asked to move the garrison to Maozhou so they could farm nearby.

sentences.zh: 」帝以松州控制西番，不可動。

translations.literal: " The emperor held that Songzhou controlled the Western Barbarians and could not be moved.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor held that Songzhou was needed to control the western tribes and could not be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 至是運道既通，松潘遂為重鎮。

translations.literal: By this time the transport route was open, and Songpan then became a major stronghold.
translations.idiomatic: Once the transport routes were open, Songpan became a major stronghold.

sentences.zh: 帝嘉其勞。

translations.literal: The emperor praised his labor.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor commended his efforts.

sentences.zh: 逾年復奏四事：一，請於雲南大寧境就井煮鹽，募商輸粟以贍邊。

translations.literal: After more than a year he again memorialized on four matters: first, requesting to boil salt at wells in the Daning border region of Yunnan and recruit merchants to transport grain to support the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: The following year he memorialized on four matters. First, he asked to boil salt at wells in the Daning border region of Yunnan and recruit merchants to transport grain to support the frontier.

sentences.zh: 一，令商入粟雲南建昌，給以重慶、綦江市馬之引。

translations.literal: Second, ordering merchants to bring grain into Jianchang in Yunnan and granting them licenses for market horses at Chongqing and Qijiang.
translations.idiomatic: Second, he proposed that merchants who brought grain to Jianchang in Yunnan be granted licenses for market horses at Chongqing and Qijiang.

sentences.zh: 一，請蠲馬湖逋租。

translations.literal: Third, requesting remission of arrears in rent at Ma Lake.
translations.idiomatic: Third, he asked for remission of rent arrears at Ma Lake.

sentences.zh: 一，施州衛軍儲仰給湖廣，溯江險遠，請以重慶粟順流輸之。

translations.literal: Fourth, the grain stores of Shizhou Guard relied on Huguang; going upriver was perilous and distant, and he requested transporting grain from Chongqing downstream.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth, Shizhou Guard's grain stores depended on Huguang, but transport upriver was dangerous and distant. He asked to supply them with grain shipped downstream from Chongqing.

sentences.zh: 皆報可。

translations.literal: All were approved.
translations.idiomatic: All were approved.

sentences.zh: 震在蜀久，諸所規畫，並極周詳。

translations.literal: Zhen was long in Shu, and all his plans were extremely thorough.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen spent many years in Shu, and all his plans were extraordinarily thorough.

sentences.zh: 蜀人德之。

translations.literal: The people of Shu were grateful to him.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Shu were deeply grateful to him.

sentences.zh: 藍玉敗，謂與震及硃壽誘指揮庄成等謀不軌，論逆黨，以震為首，並其子炳誅之。

translations.literal: When Lan Yu fell, it was said that he together with Zhen and Zhu Shou had induced the Commander Zhuang Cheng and others to plot sedition; judging the rebellious faction, with Zhen as chief, he and his son Bing were executed.
translations.idiomatic: When Lan Yu fell, Zhen and Zhu Shou were accused of inducing the commander Zhuang Cheng and others to plot sedition. Zhen was named chief among the rebels, and he and his son Bing were executed.

sentences.zh: 張翼，臨淮人。

translations.literal: Zhang Yi was a man of Linhuai.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Yi was a native of Linhuai.

sentences.zh: 父聚，以前翼元帥從平江南、淮東，積功為大同衛指揮同知，致仕。

translations.literal: His father Ju, formerly a wing marshal, followed in the pacification of Jiangnan and Huaidong; through accumulated merit he became Vice Commander of the Datong Guard and retired.
translations.idiomatic: His father Ju had served as a wing marshal in the pacification of Jiangnan and Huaidong and, for accumulated merit, rose to vice commander of the Datong Guard before retiring.

sentences.zh: 翼隨父軍中，驍勇善戰，以副千戶嗣父職。

translations.literal: Yi followed his father in the army, was fierce and skilled in battle, and as Deputy Centurion succeeded to his father's post.
translations.idiomatic: Yi followed his father in the army. Fierce and skilled in battle, he succeeded to his father's post as deputy centurion.

sentences.zh: 從征陝西，擒叛寇。

translations.literal: He followed the campaign in Shaanxi and captured rebel bandits.
translations.idiomatic: He campaigned in Shaanxi and captured rebel bandits.

sentences.zh: 擢都指揮僉事，進僉都督府事。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Associate Regional Commander and advanced to Associate Director of the Chief Military Commission.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to associate regional commander and then to associate director of the chief military commission.

sentences.zh: 從藍玉征雲南，克普定、曲靖。

translations.literal: He followed Lan Yu in the campaign against Yunnan and captured Puding and Qujing.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Lan Yu into Yunnan and captured Puding and Qujing.

sentences.zh: 取鶴慶、麗江，剿七百房山寨。

translations.literal: He took Heqing and Lijiang and suppressed the stockades of the Seven Hundred Houses.
translations.idiomatic: He took Heqing and Lijiang and suppressed the stockades of the Seven Hundred Houses.

sentences.zh: 搗劍川，擊石門。

translations.literal: He raided Jianchuan and attacked Shimen.
translations.idiomatic: He raided Jianchuan and attacked Shimen.

sentences.zh: 十七年論功封鶴慶侯，祿二千五百石，予世券。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, when merit was assessed, he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Heqing with an income of two thousand five hundred piculs of grain and granted a hereditary patent.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, for his merit, he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Heqing with an income of 2,500 piculs of grain and granted a hereditary patent of nobility.

sentences.zh: 二十六年坐玉黨死。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year he was executed by association with Yu's faction.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-sixth year he was executed as a member of Yu's faction.

sentences.zh: 張溫，不詳何許人。

translations.literal: Zhang Wen—it is not clear from where he came.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Wen's place of origin is not recorded.

sentences.zh: 從太祖渡江，授千戶。

translations.literal: He followed the Taizu in crossing the river and was appointed Centurion.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the Taizu across the Yangzi and was appointed centurion.

sentences.zh: 積功至天策衛指揮僉事。

translations.literal: Through accumulated merit he reached Associate Commander of the Tianche Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Through accumulated merit he rose to associate commander of the Tianche Guard.

sentences.zh: 從大軍收中原，克陝西，攻下蘭州，守之。

translations.literal: He followed the great army in recovering the Central Plains, captured Shaanxi, attacked and took Lanzhou, and defended it.
translations.idiomatic: He followed the main army in recovering the Central Plains, took Shaanxi, captured Lanzhou, and was left to defend it.

sentences.zh: 元將擴廓偵大將軍南還，自甘肅帥步騎奄至。

translations.literal: The Yuan general Köke Temür, learning that the great general had returned south, led infantry and cavalry from Gansu to arrive suddenly.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan general Köke Temür, learning that the main army had returned south, led infantry and cavalry from Gansu in a sudden assault.

sentences.zh: 諸將請固守以待援。

translations.literal: The generals requested to hold firm and wait for reinforcements.
